queries.description: Get the latest readings for all parameters at a specific station (site), or all permitted stations if no station is specified. Use for site/station names, NOT device names.
patterns: what is the AQI at station
queries.sql: SELECT pr.CreatedTime, s.StationName, p.ParameterName, pr.Parametervalue, u.UnitName, pr.SubIndex, pr.Alarm FROM ParameterReadings pr JOIN DMN_Stations s ON pr.StationID = s.ID JOIN DMN_Parameters p ON pr.ParameterID = p.ID JOIN ReportedUnits u ON p.UnitID = u.ID WHERE pr.StationID = @stationId AND pr.Status = 1 AND pr.CreatedTime >= DATEADD(HOUR, -2, GETUTCDATE()) ORDER BY s.StationName, p.ParameterName, pr.CreatedTime DESC

queries.description: Get the latest readings for ALL parameters across ALL accessible stations. Use when user asks for current readings, site readings, what are sites reading now, current data for all sites — with NO specific pollutant mentioned.
patterns: what are the current sites readings
queries.sql: SELECT s.StationName, p.ParameterName, ROUND(pr.Parametervalue, 2) AS ParameterValue, u.UnitName, CONVERT(varchar, pr.CreatedTime, 120) AS LastUpdated FROM ParameterReadings pr JOIN DMN_Stations s ON pr.StationID = s.ID JOIN DMN_Parameters p ON pr.ParameterID = p.ID JOIN ReportedUnits u ON p.UnitID = u.ID WHERE pr.Status = 1 AND pr.CreatedTime >= DATEADD(HOUR, -1, GETUTCDATE()) AND p.ParameterName IN ('AQI Index','PM2.5','PM10','CO','CO2','NO2','O3','SO2','Temperature','Humidity') ORDER BY s.StationName, p.ParameterName

queries.description: Show hourly average trend for a pollutant at a station over a date range
queries.sql: SELECT pa.Interval, AVG(pa.Parametervalue) as AvgValue, MAX(pa.Parametervalue) as MaxValue, MIN(pa.Parametervalue) as MinValue, p.ParameterName, u.UnitName, s.StationName FROM ParameterAverages pa JOIN DMN_Stations s ON pa.StationID = s.ID JOIN DMN_Parameters p ON pa.ParameterID = p.ID JOIN ReportedUnits u ON p.UnitID = u.ID WHERE pa.StationID = @stationId AND p.ParameterName = @parameterName AND pa.Interval BETWEEN @startDate AND @endDate AND pa.Status = 1 GROUP BY pa.Interval, p.ParameterName, u.UnitName, s.StationName ORDER BY pa.Interval

queries.description: Show monthly average trend for a pollutant at a station
queries.sql: SELECT pam.Interval, AVG(pam.Parametervalue) as AvgValue, MAX(pam.Parametervalue) as MaxValue, p.ParameterName, u.UnitName, s.StationName FROM ParameterAveragesMonth pam JOIN DMN_Stations s ON pam.StationID = s.ID JOIN DMN_Parameters p ON pam.ParameterID = p.ID JOIN ReportedUnits u ON p.UnitID = u.ID WHERE pam.StationID = @stationId AND p.ParameterName = @parameterName AND pam.Interval BETWEEN @startDate AND @endDate AND pam.Status = 1 GROUP BY pam.Interval, p.ParameterName, u.UnitName, s.StationName ORDER BY pam.Interval

queries.description: Compare a pollutant between two stations over a date range
queries.sql: SELECT pa.Interval, s.StationName, AVG(pa.Parametervalue) as AvgValue, p.ParameterName, u.UnitName FROM ParameterAverages pa JOIN DMN_Stations s ON pa.StationID = s.ID JOIN DMN_Parameters p ON pa.ParameterID = p.ID JOIN ReportedUnits u ON p.UnitID = u.ID WHERE pa.StationID IN (@stationId1, @stationId2) AND p.ParameterName = @parameterName AND pa.Interval BETWEEN @startDate AND @endDate AND pa.Status = 1 GROUP BY pa.Interval, s.StationName, p.ParameterName, u.UnitName ORDER BY pa.Interval, s.StationName

queries.description: Find the worst air-quality month at a specific site in a given year — returns the month with highest avg AQI, the top pollutants with exceedance counts, and the peak single AQI reading. Uses ParameterAveragesMonth for monthly AQI, Parameters_Excedence_Values for thresholds, and ParameterAverages for peak hourly reading.

queries.sql: WITH MonthlyAvg AS ( SELECT MONTH(pam.Interval) AS [Month], YEAR(pam.Interval) AS [Year], ROUND(AVG(CAST(pam.Parametervalue AS FLOAT)), 1) AS AvgAQI, MAX(CAST(pam.Parametervalue AS FLOAT)) AS MaxAQI FROM ParameterAveragesMonth pam JOIN DMN_Parameters p ON pam.ParameterID = p.ID JOIN DMN_Stations s ON pam.StationID = s.ID WHERE p.ParameterName = 'AQI Index' AND s.StationName LIKE '%' + @stationName + '%' AND YEAR(pam.Interval) = @year GROUP BY MONTH(pam.Interval), YEAR(pam.Interval) ), WorstMonth AS ( SELECT TOP 1 * FROM MonthlyAvg ORDER BY AvgAQI DESC ), Exceedances AS ( SELECT p.ParameterName, COUNT(*) AS ExceedanceCount FROM ParameterAverages pa JOIN DMN_Parameters p ON pa.ParameterID = p.ID JOIN DMN_Stations s ON pa.StationID = s.ID JOIN Parameters_Excedence_Values ev ON ev.Parameter = p.ParameterName AND ev.Interval = 24 WHERE s.StationName LIKE '%' + @stationName + '%' AND MONTH(pa.Interval) = (SELECT [Month] FROM WorstMonth) AND YEAR(pa.Interval) = @year AND pa.Parametervalue > ev.ExcedenceValue AND pa.Status = 1 AND p.ParameterName <> 'AQI Index' GROUP BY p.ParameterName ) SELECT wm.[Month], wm.[Year], wm.AvgAQI, wm.MaxAQI, e.ParameterName, e.ExceedanceCount FROM WorstMonth wm CROSS JOIN Exceedances e ORDER BY e.ExceedanceCount DESC

queries.description: Rank regions by AQI quality over the last N years considering data completeness. Queries ParameterAveragesYear for avg AQI + days above 100 per region per year, and DeviceCompliance for DSR. Use when user asks which region had the poorest/best air quality over multiple years.

queries.sql: SELECT r.RegionName, YEAR(pay.Interval) AS [Year], ROUND(AVG(CAST(pay.Parametervalue AS FLOAT)), 1) AS AvgAQI, COUNT(CASE WHEN pay.Parametervalue > 100 THEN 1 END) AS HighDays, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN dc.IsActive = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CAST(dc.RecordedDate AS DATE)), 0), 1) AS DSR_Pct FROM ParameterAveragesYear pay JOIN DMN_Parameters p ON pay.ParameterID = p.ID JOIN DMN_Devices d ON p.DeviceID = d.DeviceId JOIN DMN_Stations s ON d.StationID = s.ID JOIN Regions r ON s.RegionID = r.Id LEFT JOIN DeviceCompliance dc ON dc.DeviceId = d.ID AND YEAR(dc.RecordedDate) = YEAR(pay.Interval) WHERE p.ParameterName = 'AQI Index' AND YEAR(pay.Interval) > YEAR(GETDATE()) - @years AND YEAR(pay.Interval) <= YEAR(GETDATE()) GROUP BY r.RegionName, YEAR(pay.Interval) ORDER BY r.RegionName, YEAR(pay.Interval) ASC

queries.description: Compare all regions by AQI performance for a single specific year, showing avg AQI, days above 100, and DSR. Use when user asks which region performed best or worst in a specific year with data completeness considered.
queries.sql: SELECT r.RegionName, YEAR(pay.Interval) AS [Year], ROUND(AVG(CAST(pay.Parametervalue AS FLOAT)), 1) AS AvgAQI, COUNT(CASE WHEN pay.Parametervalue > 100 THEN 1 END) AS HighDays, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN dc.IsActive = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CAST(dc.RecordedDate AS DATE)), 0), 1) AS DSR_Pct FROM ParameterAveragesYear pay JOIN DMN_Parameters p ON pay.ParameterID = p.ID JOIN DMN_Devices d ON p.DeviceID = d.DeviceId JOIN DMN_Stations s ON d.StationID = s.ID JOIN Regions r ON s.RegionID = r.Id LEFT JOIN DeviceCompliance dc ON dc.DeviceId = d.ID AND YEAR(dc.RecordedDate) = YEAR(pay.Interval) WHERE p.ParameterName = 'AQI Index' AND YEAR(pay.Interval) = @year GROUP BY r.RegionName, YEAR(pay.Interval) ORDER BY AvgAQI ASC

queries.sql: WITH SitePeak AS ( SELECT TOP 1 pa.Interval, AVG(CAST(pa.Parametervalue AS FLOAT)) AS SiteAvgAQI FROM ParameterAverages pa JOIN DMN_Parameters p ON pa.ParameterID = p.ID JOIN DMN_Stations s ON pa.StationID = s.ID WHERE p.ParameterName = 'AQI Index' AND s.StationName LIKE '%' + @stationName + '%' AND pa.Interval >= DATEADD(MONTH, DATEDIFF(MONTH, 0, GETDATE()) - 1, 0) AND pa.Interval < DATEADD(MONTH, DATEDIFF(MONTH, 0, GETDATE()), 0) AND pa.Status = 1 GROUP BY pa.Interval ORDER BY SiteAvgAQI DESC ) SELECT d.DeviceName, ROUND(CAST(pa.Parametervalue AS FLOAT), 1) AS AQI, sp.Interval AS PeakDateTime, ROUND(sp.SiteAvgAQI, 1) AS SiteAQI FROM SitePeak sp JOIN ParameterAverages pa ON pa.Interval = sp.Interval JOIN DMN_Parameters p ON pa.ParameterID = p.ID JOIN DMN_Devices d ON p.DeviceID = d.DeviceId JOIN DMN_Stations s ON pa.StationID = s.ID WHERE p.ParameterName = 'AQI Index' AND s.StationName LIKE '%' + @stationName + '%' AND pa.Status = 1 ORDER BY pa.Parametervalue DESC

queries.description: Compare the two devices at a specific site for a given month — shows each device's monthly average AQI and Data Success Rate. Use when user asks to compare devices at a school or site for a specific month/year.
patterns: how do the two devices at
queries.sql: SELECT d.DeviceName, ROUND(AVG(CAST(pam.Parametervalue AS FLOAT)), 1) AS AvgAQI, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN dc.IsActive = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(dc.Id), 0), 1) AS DSR_Pct FROM ParameterAveragesMonth pam JOIN DMN_Parameters p ON pam.ParameterID = p.ID JOIN DMN_Devices d ON p.DeviceID = d.DeviceId JOIN DMN_Stations s ON pam.StationID = s.ID LEFT JOIN DeviceCompliance dc ON dc.DeviceId = d.DeviceId AND MONTH(dc.RecordedDate) = @month AND YEAR(dc.RecordedDate) = @year WHERE p.ParameterName = 'AQI Index' AND s.StationName LIKE '%' + @stationName + '%' AND MONTH(pam.Interval) = @month AND YEAR(pam.Interval) = @year GROUP BY d.DeviceName ORDER BY d.DeviceName

queries.description: Find the stations with the highest pollutant readings over a period
queries.sql: SELECT TOP 10 s.StationName, p.ParameterName, AVG(pa.Parametervalue) as AvgValue, MAX(pa.Parametervalue) as PeakValue, u.UnitName FROM ParameterAverages pa JOIN DMN_Stations s ON pa.StationID = s.ID JOIN DMN_Parameters p ON pa.ParameterID = p.ID JOIN ReportedUnits u ON p.UnitID = u.ID WHERE p.ParameterName = @parameterName AND pa.Interval BETWEEN @startDate AND @endDate AND pa.Status = 1 GROUP BY s.StationName, p.ParameterName, u.UnitName ORDER BY AvgValue DESC

queries.description: Find the stations with the lowest (best) pollutant readings over a period
queries.sql: SELECT TOP 10 s.StationName, p.ParameterName, AVG(pa.Parametervalue) as AvgValue, MIN(pa.Parametervalue) as MinValue, u.UnitName FROM ParameterAverages pa JOIN DMN_Stations s ON pa.StationID = s.ID JOIN DMN_Parameters p ON pa.ParameterID = p.ID JOIN ReportedUnits u ON p.UnitID = u.ID WHERE p.ParameterName = @parameterName AND pa.Interval BETWEEN @startDate AND @endDate AND pa.Status = 1 GROUP BY s.StationName, p.ParameterName, u.UnitName ORDER BY AvgValue ASC

queries.description: Calculate the average, min, and max of a pollutant at a station over a date range
queries.sql: SELECT s.StationName, p.ParameterName, u.UnitName, AVG(pa.Parametervalue) as Average, MIN(pa.Parametervalue) as Minimum, MAX(pa.Parametervalue) as Maximum, COUNT(*) as ReadingCount FROM ParameterAverages pa JOIN DMN_Stations s ON pa.StationID = s.ID JOIN DMN_Parameters p ON pa.ParameterID = p.ID JOIN ReportedUnits u ON p.UnitID = u.ID WHERE pa.StationID = @stationId AND p.ParameterName = @parameterName AND pa.Interval BETWEEN @startDate AND @endDate AND pa.Status = 1 GROUP BY s.StationName, p.ParameterName, u.UnitName

queries.description: Count how many readings exceeded the MOCCAE standard threshold for a pollutant at a station
queries.sql: SELECT s.StationName, p.ParameterName, ev.ExcedenceValue, u.UnitName, COUNT(*) as ExceedanceCount, MAX(pa.Parametervalue) as PeakValue FROM ParameterAverages pa JOIN DMN_Stations s ON pa.StationID = s.ID JOIN DMN_Parameters p ON pa.ParameterID = p.ID JOIN ReportedUnits u ON p.UnitID = u.ID JOIN Parameters_Excedence_Values ev ON ev.Parameter = p.ParameterName WHERE pa.StationID = @stationId AND p.ParameterName = @parameterName AND pa.Interval BETWEEN @startDate AND @endDate AND pa.Parametervalue > ev.ExcedenceValue AND pa.Status = 1 GROUP BY s.StationName, p.ParameterName, ev.ExcedenceValue, u.UnitName

queries.description: Count exceedances across all stations for a pollutant — ranked worst to best
queries.sql: SELECT s.StationName, p.ParameterName, ev.ExcedenceValue, u.UnitName, COUNT(*) as ExceedanceCount, MAX(pa.Parametervalue) as PeakValue FROM ParameterAverages pa JOIN DMN_Stations s ON pa.StationID = s.ID JOIN DMN_Parameters p ON pa.ParameterID = p.ID JOIN ReportedUnits u ON p.UnitID = u.ID JOIN Parameters_Excedence_Values ev ON ev.Parameter = p.ParameterName WHERE p.ParameterName = @parameterName AND pa.Interval BETWEEN @startDate AND @endDate AND pa.Parametervalue > ev.ExcedenceValue AND pa.Status = 1 GROUP BY s.StationName, p.ParameterName, ev.ExcedenceValue, u.UnitName ORDER BY ExceedanceCount DESC

queries.description: Rank all stations by average pollutant level
queries.sql: SELECT s.StationName, p.ParameterName, AVG(pa.Parametervalue) as AvgValue, MAX(pa.Parametervalue) as PeakValue, u.UnitName FROM ParameterAverages pa JOIN DMN_Stations s ON pa.StationID = s.ID JOIN DMN_Parameters p ON pa.ParameterID = p.ID JOIN ReportedUnits u ON p.UnitID = u.ID WHERE p.ParameterName = @parameterName AND pa.Interval BETWEEN @startDate AND @endDate AND pa.Status = 1 GROUP BY s.StationName, p.ParameterName, u.UnitName ORDER BY AvgValue DESC

queries.description: Hourly breakdown of a pollutant at a station on a specific date
queries.sql: SELECT DATEPART(HOUR, pa.Interval) as Hour, AVG(pa.Parametervalue) as AvgValue, MAX(pa.Parametervalue) as MaxValue, p.ParameterName, u.UnitName FROM ParameterAverages pa JOIN DMN_Parameters p ON pa.ParameterID = p.ID JOIN ReportedUnits u ON p.UnitID = u.ID WHERE pa.StationID = @stationId AND p.ParameterName = @parameterName AND CAST(pa.Interval AS DATE) = @targetDate AND pa.Status = 1 GROUP BY DATEPART(HOUR, pa.Interval), p.ParameterName, u.UnitName ORDER BY Hour

queries.description: Find which hours of the day have the highest pollution levels on average
queries.sql: SELECT DATEPART(HOUR, pa.Interval) as Hour, AVG(pa.Parametervalue) as AvgValue, COUNT(*) as ReadingCount FROM ParameterAverages pa JOIN DMN_Parameters p ON pa.ParameterID = p.ID WHERE pa.StationID = @stationId AND p.ParameterName = @parameterName AND pa.Interval BETWEEN @startDate AND @endDate AND pa.Status = 1 GROUP BY DATEPART(HOUR, pa.Interval) ORDER BY AvgValue DESC

queries.description: Get all pollutant averages at a station for a date range — multi-pollutant overview
queries.sql: SELECT p.ParameterName, u.UnitName, AVG(pa.Parametervalue) as AvgValue, MIN(pa.Parametervalue) as MinValue, MAX(pa.Parametervalue) as MaxValue FROM ParameterAverages pa JOIN DMN_Parameters p ON pa.ParameterID = p.ID JOIN ReportedUnits u ON p.UnitID = u.ID WHERE pa.StationID = @stationId AND pa.Interval BETWEEN @startDate AND @endDate AND pa.Status = 1 GROUP BY p.ParameterName, u.UnitName ORDER BY p.ParameterName

queries.description: Month-over-month comparison of a pollutant at a station
queries.sql: SELECT FORMAT(pam.Interval, 'yyyy-MM') as Month, AVG(pam.Parametervalue) as AvgValue, MAX(pam.Parametervalue) as MaxValue, p.ParameterName, u.UnitName FROM ParameterAveragesMonth pam JOIN DMN_Parameters p ON pam.ParameterID = p.ID JOIN ReportedUnits u ON p.UnitID = u.ID WHERE pam.StationID = @stationId AND p.ParameterName = @parameterName AND pam.Interval BETWEEN @startDate AND @endDate AND pam.Status = 1 GROUP BY FORMAT(pam.Interval, 'yyyy-MM'), p.ParameterName, u.UnitName ORDER BY Month

queries.description: Worst pollutant readings across all stations in the past 7 days
queries.sql: SELECT TOP 20 s.StationName, p.ParameterName, AVG(pa.Parametervalue) as AvgValue, MAX(pa.Parametervalue) as PeakValue, u.UnitName FROM ParameterAverages pa JOIN DMN_Stations s ON pa.StationID = s.ID JOIN DMN_Parameters p ON pa.ParameterID = p.ID JOIN ReportedUnits u ON p.UnitID = u.ID WHERE p.ParameterName = @parameterName AND pa.Interval >= DATEADD(DAY, -7, GETUTCDATE()) AND pa.Status = 1 GROUP BY s.StationName, p.ParameterName, u.UnitName ORDER BY AvgValue DESC

queries.description: List priority hotspot sites (sites with critically high AQI) from the Executive Dashboard. Returns the site names flagged as critical/hotspot for the given year. Use when the user asks about hotspots, priority hotspots, critical sites, or which sites have the worst air quality from the dashboard.
Device uptime/compliance rate for a station over a date range
queries.sql: SELECT s.StationName, d.DeviceName, COUNT(*) as ActiveDays, DATEDIFF(DAY, @startDate, @endDate) + 1 as TotalDays, CAST(COUNT(*) AS FLOAT) / (DATEDIFF(DAY, @startDate, @endDate) + 1) * 100 as CompliancePct FROM DeviceCompliance dc JOIN DMN_Devices d ON dc.DeviceId = d.ID JOIN DMN_Stations s ON d.StationID = s.ID WHERE d.StationID = @stationId AND dc.RecordedDate BETWEEN @startDate AND @endDate AND dc.IsActive = 1 GROUP BY s.StationName, d.DeviceName ORDER BY CompliancePct DESC

queries.description: List devices with the lowest Data Success Rate last month, ranked ascending. Use when user asks which devices had the lowest DSR, worst compliance, or least data last month.

queries.sql: SELECT TOP @topN d.DeviceName, s.StationName, r.RegionName, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN dc.IsActive = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(dc.Id), 0), 1) AS DSR_Pct FROM DeviceCompliance dc JOIN DMN_Devices d ON dc.DeviceId = d.ID JOIN DMN_Stations s ON d.StationID = s.ID LEFT JOIN Regions r ON s.RegionID = r.Id WHERE MONTH(dc.RecordedDate) = MONTH(DATEADD(MONTH, -1, GETDATE())) AND YEAR(dc.RecordedDate) = YEAR(DATEADD(MONTH, -1, GETDATE())) GROUP BY d.DeviceName, s.StationName, r.RegionName ORDER BY DSR_Pct ASC

queries.description: List all stations in a specific sector with their current status
queries.sql: SELECT s.ID, s.StationName, s.OrganizationName, s.Location, sec.SectorName, sub.SectorName as SubSectorName, r.RegionName, CASE s.Status WHEN 1 THEN 'Active' ELSE 'Inactive' END AS Status FROM DMN_Stations s LEFT JOIN Sectors sec ON s.SectorID = sec.Id LEFT JOIN SubSectors sub ON s.SubSectorID = sub.Id LEFT JOIN Regions r ON s.RegionID = r.Id WHERE ISNULL(s.IsDeleted, 0) = 0 AND sec.SectorName = @sectorName ORDER BY s.StationName

queries.description: Temperature and humidity trend over time (historical chart) — only use when user asks for trend, chart, graph, or history
queries.sql: SELECT pa.Interval, p.ParameterName, AVG(pa.Parametervalue) as AvgValue, u.UnitName FROM ParameterAverages pa JOIN DMN_Parameters p ON pa.ParameterID = p.ID JOIN ReportedUnits u ON p.UnitID = u.ID WHERE pa.StationID = @stationId AND p.ParameterName IN ('Temperature', 'Humidity') AND pa.Interval BETWEEN @startDate AND @endDate AND pa.Status = 1 GROUP BY pa.Interval, p.ParameterName, u.UnitName ORDER BY pa.Interval, p.ParameterName

queries.description: CO2 and TVOC trend over time (historical chart) at a station — only use when user asks for trend, chart, graph, or history
queries.sql: SELECT pa.Interval, p.ParameterName, AVG(pa.Parametervalue) as AvgValue, u.UnitName FROM ParameterAverages pa JOIN DMN_Parameters p ON pa.ParameterID = p.ID JOIN ReportedUnits u ON p.UnitID = u.ID WHERE pa.StationID = @stationId AND p.ParameterName IN ('CO2', 'TVOC') AND pa.Interval BETWEEN @startDate AND @endDate AND pa.Status = 1 GROUP BY pa.Interval, p.ParameterName, u.UnitName ORDER BY pa.Interval, p.ParameterName

queries.description: List devices with full details (DeviceName, StationName, RegionName, SectorName, SubSectorName, Status, LastActive, latest AQI) for one or more SPECIFIC SITE NAMES. Use when the user mentions a specific site or school name (e.g. 'devices under Al Naeem School', 'devices at Al Saad Indian School and Al Bateen School'). stationName is required — it filters by partial match so a keyword like 'Naeem' or 'Saad' works. For region-only or sector-only device queries use devices_by_filter instead.
patterns: what devices are in this site
queries.sql: SELECT d.DeviceName, s.StationName, r.RegionName, sec.SectorName, ss.SectorName AS SubSectorName, CASE WHEN MAX(p.ParameterReadingUpdateTime) >= DATEADD(MINUTE, -15, GETDATE()) THEN 'Active' ELSE 'Inactive' END AS Status, MAX(p.ParameterReadingUpdateTime) AS LastActive, MAX(CASE WHEN p.ParameterName = 'AQI Index' THEN p.ParameterValue END) AS AQI FROM DMN_Devices d JOIN DMN_Stations s ON d.StationID = s.ID LEFT JOIN Regions r ON s.RegionID = r.Id LEFT JOIN Sectors sec ON s.SectorID = sec.Id LEFT JOIN SubSectors ss ON s.SubSectorID = ss.Id LEFT JOIN DMN_Parameters p ON p.DeviceID = d.DeviceId WHERE d.Status = 1 AND ISNULL(d.IsEnable, 1) = 1 AND ISNULL(d.IsDeleted, 0) = 0 AND REPLACE(LOWER(s.StationName), ' ', '') LIKE '%' + REPLACE(LOWER(@stationName), ' ', '') + '%' GROUP BY d.DeviceName, s.StationName, r.RegionName, sec.SectorName, ss.SectorName ORDER BY s.StationName, d.DeviceName

queries.sql: SELECT s.StationName, r.RegionName, sec.SectorName, CASE WHEN MAX(p.ParameterReadingUpdateTime) >= DATEADD(MINUTE, -15, GETDATE()) THEN 'Active' ELSE 'Inactive' END AS LiveStatus FROM DMN_Stations s JOIN Regions r ON s.RegionID = r.Id LEFT JOIN Sectors sec ON s.SectorID = sec.Id LEFT JOIN DMN_Devices d ON d.StationID = s.ID AND d.Status = 1 AND ISNULL(d.IsEnable,1) = 1 AND ISNULL(d.IsDeleted,0) = 0 LEFT JOIN DMN_Parameters p ON p.DeviceID = d.DeviceId WHERE s.Status = 1 AND ISNULL(s.IsDeleted, 0) = 0 AND REPLACE(LOWER(r.RegionName),' ','') = REPLACE(LOWER(@regionName),' ','') GROUP BY s.StationName, r.RegionName, sec.SectorName ORDER BY s.StationName

queries.sql: SELECT s.StationName, sec.SectorName, sub.SectorName AS SubSectorName, r.RegionName, CASE WHEN MAX(p.ParameterReadingUpdateTime) >= DATEADD(MINUTE, -15, GETDATE()) THEN 'Active' ELSE 'Inactive' END AS LiveStatus FROM DMN_Stations s LEFT JOIN Sectors sec ON s.SectorID = sec.Id LEFT JOIN SubSectors sub ON s.SubSectorID = sub.Id LEFT JOIN Regions r ON s.RegionID = r.Id LEFT JOIN DMN_Devices d ON d.StationID = s.ID AND d.Status = 1 AND ISNULL(d.IsEnable,1) = 1 AND ISNULL(d.IsDeleted,0) = 0 LEFT JOIN DMN_Parameters p ON p.DeviceID = d.DeviceId WHERE s.Status = 1 AND ISNULL(s.IsDeleted, 0) = 0 AND REPLACE(LOWER(r.RegionName),' ','') = REPLACE(LOWER(@regionName),' ','') GROUP BY s.StationName, sec.SectorName, sub.SectorName, r.RegionName ORDER BY s.StationName

queries.description: Get the latest reading of a specific pollutant (CO, NO2, SO2, CO2, PM2.5, AQI, etc.) across all sites in a specific sector (Commercial, Residential, Public & Govt-School), optionally filtered by region. Use whenever the user asks for a parameter reading for a sector.

queries.description: List sites filtered by sector (Commercial, Public & Govt-School, Residential), optionally also filtered by region (Abu Dhabi, Al Ain, Al Dhafra) and/or sub-sector. Use whenever the user names a specific sector OR asks about schools/commercial/residential sites with or without a region. ALWAYS prefer this over sites_by_region when a sector name is mentioned. Shows SubSectorName so public vs private schools are visible.
queries.sql: SELECT s.StationName, sub.SectorName AS SubSectorName, sec.SectorName, r.RegionName, CASE WHEN MAX(p.ParameterReadingUpdateTime) >= DATEADD(MINUTE, -15, GETDATE()) THEN 'Active' ELSE 'Inactive' END AS LiveStatus FROM DMN_Stations s LEFT JOIN Sectors sec ON s.SectorID = sec.Id LEFT JOIN SubSectors sub ON s.SubSectorID = sub.Id LEFT JOIN Regions r ON s.RegionID = r.Id LEFT JOIN DMN_Devices d ON d.StationID = s.ID AND d.Status = 1 AND ISNULL(d.IsEnable,1) = 1 AND ISNULL(d.IsDeleted,0) = 0 LEFT JOIN DMN_Parameters p ON p.DeviceID = d.DeviceId WHERE s.Status = 1 AND ISNULL(s.IsDeleted, 0) = 0 AND REPLACE(LOWER(sec.SectorName),' ','') LIKE '%' + REPLACE(LOWER(@sectorName),' ','') + '%' AND (@regionName IS NULL OR REPLACE(LOWER(r.RegionName),' ','') LIKE '%' + REPLACE(LOWER(@regionName),' ','') + '%') AND (@subSectorName IS NULL OR REPLACE(LOWER(sub.SectorName),' ','') LIKE '%' + REPLACE(LOWER(@subSectorName),' ','') + '%') GROUP BY s.StationName, sub.SectorName, sec.SectorName, r.RegionName ORDER BY sub.SectorName, s.StationName

queries.description: List all distinct sectors in HAWAQM and their count. Use when user asks how many sectors there are, what sectors exist, or list of sectors — with NO specific sector name mentioned.
queries.sql: SELECT sec.SectorName, COUNT(s.ID) AS TotalSites FROM Sectors sec LEFT JOIN DMN_Stations s ON s.SectorID = sec.Id AND s.Status = 1 AND ISNULL(s.IsDeleted, 0) = 0 GROUP BY sec.SectorName ORDER BY sec.SectorName

queries.description: List all distinct sub-sectors in HAWAQM and their count. Use when user asks how many sub-sectors there are, what sub-sectors exist, or list of sub-sectors.
queries.sql: SELECT ss.SectorName AS SubSectorName, sec.SectorName, COUNT(s.ID) AS TotalSites FROM SubSectors ss LEFT JOIN DMN_Stations s ON s.SubSectorID = ss.Id AND s.Status = 1 AND ISNULL(s.IsDeleted, 0) = 0 LEFT JOIN Sectors sec ON ss.ParentSectorID = sec.Id GROUP BY ss.SectorName, sec.SectorName ORDER BY sec.SectorName, ss.SectorName

queries.sql: SELECT TOP 1 s.StationName, r.RegionName, ROUND(AVG(CAST(p.ParameterValue AS FLOAT)), 0) AS MinAQI, MAX(p.ParameterReadingUpdateTime) AS LastUpdated FROM DMN_Parameters p JOIN DMN_Devices d ON p.DeviceID = d.DeviceId AND ISNULL(d.IsDeleted, 0) = 0 JOIN DMN_Stations s ON d.StationID = s.ID AND ISNULL(s.IsDeleted, 0) = 0 LEFT JOIN Regions r ON s.RegionID = r.Id WHERE p.ParameterName = 'AQI Index' AND p.ParameterReadingUpdateTime >= DATEADD(MINUTE, -30, GETDATE()) GROUP BY s.StationName, r.RegionName ORDER BY AVG(CAST(p.ParameterValue AS FLOAT)) ASC

queries.description: Rank the TOP N sites by HIGHEST average AQI for a given year using ParameterAveragesYear. Use when user asks which sites had the highest average AQI last year or in a specific year.

queries.sql: SELECT TOP @topN s.StationName, r.RegionName, ROUND(AVG(CAST(pay.Parametervalue AS FLOAT)), 1) AS AvgAQI, YEAR(pay.Interval) AS [Year] FROM ParameterAveragesYear pay JOIN DMN_Parameters p ON pay.ParameterID = p.ID JOIN DMN_Devices d ON p.DeviceID = d.DeviceId JOIN DMN_Stations s ON d.StationID = s.ID LEFT JOIN Regions r ON s.RegionID = r.Id WHERE p.ParameterName = 'AQI Index' AND YEAR(pay.Interval) = @year GROUP BY s.StationName, r.RegionName, YEAR(pay.Interval) ORDER BY AvgAQI DESC

queries.description: Rank the BOTTOM N sites by LOWEST average AQI for a given year using ParameterAveragesYear. Use when user asks which sites had the lowest or best average AQI last year or in a specific year.

queries.sql: SELECT TOP @topN s.StationName, r.RegionName, ROUND(AVG(CAST(pay.Parametervalue AS FLOAT)), 1) AS AvgAQI, YEAR(pay.Interval) AS [Year] FROM ParameterAveragesYear pay JOIN DMN_Parameters p ON pay.ParameterID = p.ID JOIN DMN_Devices d ON p.DeviceID = d.DeviceId JOIN DMN_Stations s ON d.StationID = s.ID LEFT JOIN Regions r ON s.RegionID = r.Id WHERE p.ParameterName = 'AQI Index' AND YEAR(pay.Interval) = @year GROUP BY s.StationName, r.RegionName, YEAR(pay.Interval) ORDER BY AvgAQI ASC

queries.description: List all sites with their current AQI values ranked from lowest to highest. Use when user asks for AQI per site, site-wise AQI, or all sites AQI ranking.

queries.sql: SELECT s.StationName, r.RegionName, ROUND(AVG(CAST(p.ParameterValue AS FLOAT)), 0) AS AQI, MAX(p.ParameterReadingUpdateTime) AS LastUpdated FROM DMN_Parameters p JOIN DMN_Devices d ON p.DeviceID = d.DeviceId AND ISNULL(d.IsDeleted, 0) = 0 JOIN DMN_Stations s ON d.StationID = s.ID AND ISNULL(s.IsDeleted, 0) = 0 LEFT JOIN Regions r ON s.RegionID = r.Id WHERE p.ParameterName = 'AQI Index' AND p.ParameterReadingUpdateTime >= DATEADD(MINUTE, -30, GETDATE()) GROUP BY s.StationName, r.RegionName ORDER BY AVG(CAST(p.ParameterValue AS FLOAT)) ASC

queries.description: Get the current average AQI from DB readings for one or all regions (Abu Dhabi, Al Ain, Al Dhafra) — use only when historical/DB-based regional AQI is explicitly needed
patterns: aqi readings by region from db
queries.sql: SELECT r.RegionName, ROUND(AVG(CAST(pr.ParameterValue AS FLOAT)), 1) AS AvgAQI, MAX(pr.ParameterValue) AS MaxAQI, MIN(pr.ParameterValue) AS MinAQI, MAX(pr.CreatedTime) AS LastUpdated, COUNT(DISTINCT s.ID) AS SiteCount FROM ParameterReadings pr JOIN DMN_Parameters dp ON pr.ParameterID = dp.ID JOIN DMN_Stations s ON pr.StationID = s.ID JOIN Regions r ON s.RegionID = r.Id WHERE dp.ParameterName = 'AQI Index' AND pr.Status = 1 AND pr.CreatedTime >= DATEADD(HOUR, -2, GETUTCDATE()) GROUP BY r.RegionName ORDER BY r.RegionName

queries.description: Count how many devices are currently active versus total registered devices for the user's permitted sites. A device is active if its last ParameterReadingUpdateTime in DMN_Parameters is within 15 minutes. Use only for HOW MANY / COUNT questions, NOT for listing which devices are online.

queries.sql: SELECT ISNULL(SUM(IsActive), 0) AS ActiveDeviceCount, COUNT(*) AS TotalDeviceCount FROM (SELECT d.DeviceId, CASE WHEN MAX(p.ParameterReadingUpdateTime) >= DATEADD(MINUTE, -15, GETDATE()) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS IsActive FROM DMN_Devices d JOIN DMN_Parameters p ON p.DeviceID = d.DeviceId JOIN DMN_Stations s ON d.StationID = s.ID WHERE d.Status = 1 AND ISNULL(d.IsEnable, 1) = 1 AND ISNULL(d.IsDeleted, 0) = 0 GROUP BY d.DeviceId) AS t

queries.sql: SELECT d.DeviceName, s.StationName, r.RegionName, sec.SectorName, ss.SectorName AS SubSectorName, CASE WHEN MAX(p.ParameterReadingUpdateTime) >= DATEADD(MINUTE, -15, GETDATE()) THEN 'Active' ELSE 'Inactive' END AS Status, MAX(p.ParameterReadingUpdateTime) AS LastActive, MAX(CASE WHEN p.ParameterName = 'AQI Index' THEN p.ParameterValue END) AS AQI FROM DMN_Devices d JOIN DMN_Parameters p ON p.DeviceID = d.DeviceId JOIN DMN_Stations s ON d.StationID = s.ID LEFT JOIN Regions r ON s.RegionID = r.Id LEFT JOIN Sectors sec ON s.SectorID = sec.Id LEFT JOIN SubSectors ss ON s.SubSectorID = ss.Id WHERE d.Status = 1 AND ISNULL(d.IsEnable, 1) = 1 AND ISNULL(d.IsDeleted, 0) = 0 AND LOWER(sec.SectorName) = LOWER(@sectorName) AND REPLACE(LOWER(r.RegionName),' ','') = REPLACE(LOWER(@regionName),' ','') GROUP BY d.DeviceName, s.StationName, r.RegionName, sec.SectorName, ss.SectorName HAVING 1=1 AND CASE WHEN MAX(p.ParameterReadingUpdateTime) >= DATEADD(MINUTE, -15, GETDATE()) THEN 'Active' ELSE 'Inactive' END = @statusFilter ORDER BY r.RegionName, sec.SectorName, s.StationName, d.DeviceName

queries.description: Get the latest readings for a specific device by device name (e.g. 'BA 0001', 'BA 0010', 'SEI100M 0014', 'SEI100M 0085'). Use when user mentions a device name with prefix BA or SEI100M followed by digits (with or without space), or uses words like 'device', 'sensor', 'reading for device'.
patterns: what is the aqi for device

queries.description: Check whether a specific device is currently active or inactive based on its last reading timestamp from DMN_Parameters. Active = last reading within 15 minutes. Inactive = last reading older than 15 minutes. Use when user asks if a device is active, online, working, sending data, or inactive.
patterns: device active or inactive right now
when did device last send data
when was last data received from device
what is the status of device
tell me the status of device
queries.sql: SELECT TOP 1 d.DeviceName, MAX(p.ParameterReadingUpdateTime) AS LastMeasured, CASE WHEN MAX(p.ParameterReadingUpdateTime) >= DATEADD(MINUTE, -15, GETDATE()) THEN 'Active' ELSE 'Inactive' END AS Status FROM DMN_Devices d JOIN DMN_Parameters p ON p.DeviceID = d.DeviceId WHERE d.Status = 1 AND ISNULL(d.IsDeleted, 0) = 0 AND (d.DeviceName = @deviceName OR REPLACE(UPPER(d.DeviceName),' ','') = REPLACE(UPPER(@deviceName),' ','') OR REPLACE(UPPER(d.DeviceName),' ','') = @paddedCanonical) GROUP BY d.DeviceName ORDER BY CASE WHEN d.DeviceName = @deviceName THEN 0 WHEN REPLACE(UPPER(d.DeviceName),' ','') = REPLACE(UPPER(@deviceName),' ','') THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, d.DeviceName

queries.description: Get metadata for a specific device by device name: site name, region, sector, sub-sector, device model, deployed/created date, last measured time, current status, and list of monitored pollutants. Use when user asks about device details, site of a device, region of a device, sector of a device, when a device was deployed/created/installed, what pollutants a device monitors, or any metadata question about a specific device (not live readings).
queries.sql: SELECT TOP 1 d.DeviceName, s.StationName, r.RegionName, sec.SectorName, ss.SectorName AS SubSectorName, d.DeviceModel, d.CreatedOn AS DeployedOn, MAX(p.ParameterReadingUpdateTime) AS LastMeasured, CASE WHEN MAX(p.ParameterReadingUpdateTime) >= DATEADD(MINUTE, -15, GETDATE()) THEN 'Active' ELSE 'Inactive' END AS Status FROM DMN_Devices d JOIN DMN_Stations s ON d.StationID = s.ID LEFT JOIN Regions r ON s.RegionID = r.Id LEFT JOIN Sectors sec ON s.SectorID = sec.Id LEFT JOIN SubSectors ss ON s.SubSectorID = ss.Id LEFT JOIN DMN_Parameters p ON p.DeviceID = d.DeviceId WHERE d.Status = 1 AND ISNULL(d.IsDeleted, 0) = 0 AND (d.DeviceName = @deviceName OR REPLACE(UPPER(d.DeviceName),' ','') = REPLACE(UPPER(@deviceName),' ','') OR REPLACE(UPPER(d.DeviceName),' ','') = @paddedCanonical) GROUP BY d.DeviceName, s.StationName, r.RegionName, sec.SectorName, ss.SectorName, d.DeviceModel, d.CreatedOn ORDER BY CASE WHEN d.DeviceName = @deviceName THEN 0 WHEN REPLACE(UPPER(d.DeviceName),' ','') = REPLACE(UPPER(@deviceName),' ','') THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, d.DeviceName

queries.description: List the parameters/pollutants monitored by a specific device. Use when the user asks what a device measures, what pollutants it monitors, or which parameters it has.
queries.sql: SELECT p.ParameterName, u.UnitName FROM DMN_Parameters p JOIN DMN_Devices d ON p.DeviceID = d.DeviceId JOIN ReportedUnits u ON p.UnitID = u.ID WHERE d.Status = 1 AND ISNULL(d.IsDeleted, 0) = 0 AND (d.DeviceName = @deviceName OR REPLACE(UPPER(d.DeviceName),' ','') = REPLACE(UPPER(@deviceName),' ','') OR REPLACE(UPPER(d.DeviceName),' ','') = @paddedCanonical) ORDER BY p.ParameterName

queries.description: Get historical readings for a specific device at a chosen time interval. Intervals: '5min' or 'live' → ParameterReadings (5-minute raw data), '1hour' or '1H' → ParameterAverages Type=1, '8hour' or '8H' → ParameterAverages Type=8, '24hour' or '24H' or 'daily' → ParameterAverages Type=24, 'monthly' or '1month' → ParameterAveragesMonth, 'yearly' or 'annual' → ParameterAveragesYear. Use when user mentions a device name AND a time interval or time period. For LIVE/CURRENT readings with no time specification, use device_last_reading instead.

queries.sql: SELECT s.StationName, r.RegionName, sec.SectorName, COUNT(DISTINCT d.DeviceId) AS TotalDevices, SUM(CASE WHEN p_live.LastReading >= DATEADD(MINUTE, -15, GETDATE()) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ActiveDevices, SUM(CASE WHEN p_live.LastReading < DATEADD(MINUTE, -15, GETDATE()) OR p_live.LastReading IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS InactiveDevices, MAX(p_live.LastReading) AS LastReadingTime, MIN(TRY_CAST(aqi_p.ParameterValue AS FLOAT)) AS BestAQI FROM DMN_Stations s LEFT JOIN Regions r ON s.RegionID = r.Id LEFT JOIN Sectors sec ON s.SectorID = sec.Id LEFT JOIN DMN_Devices d ON d.StationID = s.ID AND d.Status = 1 AND ISNULL(d.IsEnable, 1) = 1 AND ISNULL(d.IsDeleted, 0) = 0 LEFT JOIN (SELECT DeviceID, MAX(ParameterReadingUpdateTime) AS LastReading FROM DMN_Parameters GROUP BY DeviceID) p_live ON p_live.DeviceID = d.DeviceId LEFT JOIN DMN_Parameters aqi_p ON aqi_p.DeviceID = d.DeviceId AND aqi_p.ParameterName = 'AQI Index' WHERE s.Status = 1 GROUP BY s.ID, s.StationName, r.RegionName, sec.SectorName HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT d.DeviceId) >= @minDeviceCount AND COUNT(DISTINCT d.DeviceId) <= @maxDeviceCount ORDER BY s.StationName
